scope: research-only typed threshold relation integrity and opportunity coverage
material_findings: The frozen V6 threshold family key discards day-of-month while structural_intents assumes a one-dollar terminal payoff floor for paired threshold relations. Different expiries inside the same month/year can therefore be grouped even though the implication is not valid across dates.
The incumbent unsuffixed numeric ranking can choose the calendar year instead of an integer/count threshold, making count ladders such as at-least-N contracts collapse to the same threshold.
The incumbent direction vocabulary does not recognize 'or more'/'or fewer' constructions, reducing structural discovery coverage.
The incumbent optional b suffix can consume the first letter of the following word 'by', turning $100,000 by ... into a 1e14 threshold.

The typed research parser preserves threshold kind and full day-level expiry, blocks suffix bleed, excludes plain years from count-threshold selection, and recognizes or-more/or-fewer wording without changing executable edge or portfolio risk gates.

deterministic_counterexample.conclusion: Cross-expiry YES(low)+NO(high) has no guaranteed $1 payoff floor.

current_public_relevance.note: Both day-specific Bitcoin threshold ladders are contemporaneously present on Polymarket; this establishes live relevance of day-level expiry identity, not that the current V6 scanner necessarily emitted a bad bundle in the observed window.

external_context.note: Current telemetry does not justify lowering the V6 external probability handoff gate; raw Binance/GDELT rows remain q_external=null or unapproved.

required_next_evidence: Run incumbent and typed relation parsers on the same chronological 300/700-market V6 public universe.
Report recovered valid same-expiry families, rejected cross-expiry families, candidate turnover and exact relation certificates.
For every candidate bundle, verify the logical payoff floor from proposition semantics before using structural edge.
Require positive executable economics after current guard plus 1x, 1.5x and 2x cost/legging stress; candidate count alone is not success.
Do not relax max drawdown, kill switch, market/event concentration, gross exposure, or authenticated-execution prohibition.
